    Splitting off an interval summand #

    A vector v ∈ M(a) whose images vanish outside an interval U with least point a gives a morphism k_U ⟶ M; a functional on M(d), for the largest point d of U, gives a morphism M ⟶ k_U provided M has no structure maps entering U from outside. When the functional is 1 on the image of v at d, the interval k_U is a direct summand of M.
